steps.title: Analyze Registration Flow Error
steps.description: Identify that /register response does not contain a token, so calling /register directly should be followed by /login to fetch the token.

steps.title: Refactor BackendApi Registration Flow
steps.description: Modify backendApi.register to perform the POST /register request first, and on success, automatically trigger the POST /login request to retrieve the Bearer authentication token.

steps.title: Clean Up App ID in Data Operations
steps.description: Remove app_id from query parameters and bodies of general /data CRUD operations as mandated by backend data specifications.

steps.title: Verify RegisterActivity Behavior
steps.description: Ensure RegisterActivity handles registration and automatic login smoothly by securely saving the resulting token and forwarding to MainActivity.

steps.title: Perform Clean Build Check
steps.description: Prepare compile commands and assemble the workspace sources to verify correct references and packaging.

steps.title: Building Student Management
steps.description: Compile, resolve dependencies, and package the Student Management application using Gradle.
